notes: Fixes the empty POS screen and dead barcode scanning from v0.5.10 (a lost initialization block), plus your feedback items: the eye button on cart lines reveals the purchase cost inline; purchase/broken checkouts empty the cart; quick-add customer/supplier from the cart works (wrong args caused the save error) and its form resets on reopen; the customer/supplier dropdowns close when clicking elsewhere and show the default supplier; employee history popup now lists absences alongside advances; Settings tabs (Account, Network, Import/Export, Activation) are translated; logout returns the POS to sale mode. Editing a sale from history now updates it in place (MODIFIED tag, same number and date, stock and drawer corrections) instead of duplicating it. New: Telegram master toggle beside dark/light mode protected by the admin password, with quiet-hours windows (e.g. 08:00-13:00) in Notification settings.
